entries.name: Session Chat
entries.description: View and continue any agentproto daemon session's conversation in the Agentik chat UI (assistant-ui based). Pick a session from the live/recent list or deep-link with ?session=<id>; the page replays the session's full transcript, then follows it live over SSE, and lets you send follow-up prompts into the same session. Built on @agstudio/react-agentproto (SSE transcript projection, permission approval, thread list) and @agstudio/chat-starter's assistant-ui shell, reused almost as-is.
entries.tagline: Read and continue any agentproto session as a chat thread.
entries.longDescription:
Session Chat turns any agentproto session into a chat thread you can read and continue.

Pick a running or recent session, or open one directly with `?session=<id>`. The page replays the full transcript, then follows the session live as the agent works, and lets you send follow-up prompts into the same session.

## What you get

- **Transcript replay and live follow**: the whole conversation, then new turns as they stream in.
- **Tool activity at a glance**: file reads, commands and edits grouped under each reply, with the files an agent changed.
- **Reply into the session**: send a follow-up, interrupt a running turn, queue prompts while the agent works.
- **Approvals**: answer the agent's permission requests from the thread.
- **Session list**: running and recent sessions, grouped by workspace, with search and pins.
- **Start a session**: pick a harness and model and start a new chat from the same page.

## Requirements

Session Chat talks to your local agentproto daemon. Its bundled agent runs on the `mastra-agent` adapter: install it first with `agentproto install mastra-agent`.
